blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC. Invented procedures for a software demonstration.

Record a cost in the month the goods or services were received. Every bill received through business day 4 is checked for its service period; a cost incurred by month-end and not in the ledger is accrued to 2100 Accrued Liabilities and reversed on the first day of the next month.
Stage a recurring entry only when it is active and its support agrees with the schedule amount to the cent. A line without agreeing support is held, with its reason, and never forced to the schedule.

Amortize each prepaid straight-line over the period it covers. After the month's amortization, the general ledger balance must equal the prepaid schedule; a difference is investigated and corrected, not carried.

Add every capitalized asset to the fixed asset register in the month it is placed in service. Depreciate straight-line from that month, a full month in the month placed in service, with no salvage value. Register cost must equal the general ledger by account. Lives: equipment 84 months, site office units 120 months, vehicles 60 months.

Accrue wages and employer costs earned but not paid at month-end, from the latest payroll register, by the share of the pay period's workdays that fall in the month. The accrual reverses on the first day of the next month.
Accrue interest on borrowed money for the actual days in the month on the principal outstanding, at the note's rate, on the note's day-count basis.
The Controller reviews every proposed entry, the adjusted trial balance and the checklist. Entries are posted only after that review, by the person who posts journal entries.

passages.q: Must HANGS Construction Services file Form 940 for 2026?
passages.a: You're subject to FUTA tax in 2026 on the wages you pay employees who aren't farmworkers or household workers if: you paid wages of $1,500 or more in any calendar quarter in 2025 or 2026, or you had one or more employees for at least some part of a day in any 20 or more different weeks in 2025 or 20 or more different weeks in 2026.

passages.q: What are the 2026 FUTA rate, wage base and credit?
passages.a: For 2026, the FUTA tax rate is 6.0%. The tax applies to the first $7,000 you pay to each employee as wages during the year. ... The credit may be as much as 5.4% of FUTA taxable wages. If you're entitled to the maximum 5.4% credit, the FUTA tax rate after credit is 0.6%.

passages.q: Do employees' 401(k) deferrals come off FUTA wages?
passages.a: Elective employee contributions and deferrals to a plan containing a qualified cash or deferred compensation arrangement (401(k)). Generally exempt, but see section 402(g) for limitation. Taxable. Taxable.

passages.q: When is the Q3 2026 Form 941 due?
passages.a: Your Form 941 is due by the last day of the month that follows the end of the quarter. ... 3. July, August, September September 30 October 31 ... If you made timely deposits in full payment of your taxes for the quarter, you may file by the 10th day of the 2nd month that follows the end of the quarter. ... If any due date for filing falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday, you may file your return on the next business day.

passages.q: Which employees are counted on line 1, and what goes on lines 2 and 3?
passages.a: Enter the number of employees on your payroll for the pay period including March 12, June 12, September 12, or December 12, for the quarter indicated at the top of Form 941. ... Enter amounts on line 2 that would also be included in box 1 of your employees’ Forms W-2. ... Enter the federal income tax you withheld (or were required to withhold) from your employees on this quarter’s wages, tips, taxable fringe benefits, and supplemental unemployment compensation benefits.

passages.q: Which wages go on line 5a, and where does Social Security stop for each employee?
passages.a: The social security tax rate is 6.2% each for the employee and employer. The social security wage base limit is $184,500. ... For 2026, the rate of social security tax on taxable wages is 6.2% (0.062) each for the employer and employee. Stop paying social security tax on and entering an employee’s wages on line 5a when the employee’s taxable wages and tips reach $184,500 for the year. ... line 5a (column 1) x 0.124 line 5a (column 2)

sources.title: General Instructions for Forms W-2 and W-3 (2026)

passages.q: When are the 2026 Forms W-2 and W-3 due, and must they be e-filed?
passages.a: The due date for filing 2026 Forms W-2 ... and W-3 ... with the SSA is February 1, 2027, whether you file using paper forms or electronically. ... Generally, you must furnish Copies B, C, and 2 of Form W-2 to your employees by February 1, 2027. ... You must e-file Forms W-2 ... if you are required to file at least 10 information returns.

passages.q: What goes in box 1, and are the 401(k) deferrals and Washington Paid Leave premiums in it?
passages.a: Box 1-Wages, tips, other compensation. Show the total taxable wages, tips, and other compensation that you paid to your employee during the year. However, do not include elective deferrals (such as employee contributions to a section 401(k) or 403(b) plan) ... You must include the employee contribution and the employer voluntary payment as wages on the Form W-2.

passages.q: What are the 2026 Social Security limits for boxes 3 and 4, and what goes in boxes 5 and 6?
passages.a: The total of boxes 3 and 7 cannot exceed $184,500 (2026 maximum social security wage base). ... For 2026, the amount should not exceed $11,439 ... there is no wage base limit for Medicare tax ... an employer is required to withhold a 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax on any Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) wages ... in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year.

passages.q: What allowance applies to the trailer ordered in December 2024 and delivered in January 2025?
passages.a: Unless you elect out, you must take a 40% special depreciation allowance for certain qualified property acquired after September 27, 2017, and placed in service after December 31, 2024, and before January 1, 2026 (other than certain property with a long production period and certain aircraft).

passages.q: What recovery period and rates apply to the construction equipment, vehicles and computers?
passages.a: 5-year property. Automobiles, taxis, buses, helicopters, and trucks. ... Construction: Includes assets used in construction by general building, special trade, heavy, and marine construction contractors ... passages.q: What special depreciation allowance applies to the excavator, the crew 3 truck and the tablets acquired in 2025?

However, you can elect to take a 40% special depreciation allowance ... during first tax year ending after January 19, 2025, instead of taking the 100% special depreciation allowance.

policies.title: Payroll Accrual
policies.text: Accrue wages and employer costs earned but not paid at month-end, from the latest payroll register, by the share of the pay period's workdays that fall in the month. The accrual reverses on the first day of the next month.

policies.title: Interest
policies.text: Accrue interest on borrowed money for the actual days in the month on the principal outstanding, at the note's rate, on the note's day-count basis.

policies.title: Review and Posting
policies.text: The Controller reviews every proposed entry, the adjusted trial balance and the checklist. Entries are posted only after that review, by the person who posts journal entries.
